Fridge Buddy helps you reduce your food waste by warning you when one of your products is approaching its Use By Date (BBD). All you have to do is scan the barcode as well as the expiration date of the food products you want to monitor. You will receive a notification when the deadline approaches.

HOW IT WORKS ?

Start by scanning the barcode and then the expiry date of your various items in your fridge, freezer or cupboards. Fridge Buddy is responsible for retrieving information related to this product. The name, photo and expiration date will be pre-filled if you have scanned it.

A few days (customizable interval) before this date, you will receive a notification reminding you to consume this product.

FEATURES

- Unlimited number of tracked products
- Notification for each tracked product approaching its BBD
- Expiration date scan, adding a product has never been so fast
- Smart lists, your product automatically grouped by categories (scheduled, expired)
- Synchronization with iCloud, find all your scanned products on all your devices
- Sharing via iCloud, you can share your lists with other users of the application
- Widget available to see soon to expire products at a glance
- Waste report, you can view and track the ratio of items consumed / discarded month by month.
- Export of your lists in a CSV file
